incompatible_sources_listed_not_ranked.reason: changes VEGLC transport gate (non-Vmax/transport), 46-day horizon, pre-gem_corrected context
changes km_ATP_HK and VELAC transport, 46-day horizon, different initial-state context
synthetic-teacher or reduced transport-only RHS; not the target network/initial state

context.fingerprint: sha256 of design, observations, transitive local import closure of the evaluator (ast, scripts/ and src/), profile, backend, SciPy version
context.cache_rule: archived rows are reused only if the campaign itself recorded hashes for the WHOLE current closure and they are equal; otherwise they are unqualified screening hints and matched replays are run inside the restoration budget

matched_replays.drift_rule: fallback vectors replayed under current sources must match their archived strict-joint rows within comparison_atol_mM + comparison_rtol*max(|a|,|b|); otherwise blocked_source_drift

release_objective.channel_rule: panel observation names intersected with rbc_gem_audit.EXTERNAL_POOLS keys
release_objective.scale: inherited working band 0.05*median(J1,J4,J8,J11,J15)+0.2*target (not an assay SD)
release_objective.units: observations.json has no unit field: unit_status = assumed_mM_historical_model_convention unless the archive records units; never presented as source-verified; no unit conversion, no relative-to-mM inference
release_objective.zero_band_points: excluded from normalized scores; reported as absolute error in the archived unit; existing zero: guards still apply
release_objective.undefined_scale_channels: channels with no positive band are excluded from the utility and listed; governed by their absolute-error guards
release_objective.primary: U = mean over channels with a defined band of 0.5*[log1p(MSE_c) - log1p(MSE_anchor_c)]; MSE_c is the band-normalized MSE over positive-band dates; equal channel weight
release_objective.primary_scale_note: the added 1 is an explicit dimensionless utility scale, not an assay variance, uncertainty or fitted parameter; exact agreement (MSE_c = 0) is finite and accepted
release_objective.release_anchor: working_centre qualified 2026-11-09 full/strict profile (fixed centring constant; it does not change rankings)
release_objective.mean: mean over scored channels of per-channel normalized RMSE (reported, absolute)
release_objective.worst: max over scored channels of per-channel normalized RMSE (reported)
release_objective.dated: root mean square of band-normalized extracellular residuals per date J4/J8/J11/J15
release_objective.global_worst_cap: every scored channel normalized RMSE <= the best qualified fallback's WORST channel (EINO-dominated; a global cap, NOT per-species non-regression)
release_objective.focus_protection: for EGLC and ELAC: normalized RMSE, |J15 residual| and |J4-J15 secant-slope error| <= fallback value + allowance
release_objective.focus_allowance_formula: delta_d = comparison_atol_mM + comparison_rtol*|x_fallback,d| (inherited 1e-5, 0.01); RMSE: sqrt(mean_d (delta_d/band_d)^2); J15: delta_J15; slope: (delta_J4 + delta_J15)/11; computed once from the selected fallback, reported, never tuned
release_objective.improvement_rule: U_new < U_fallback - log1p(0.001) (absolute change in utility units, not a % of RMSE), worst channel not worse than fallback, focus protections, 84 reserved guards, strict+ultrastrict qualification with paired convergence
release_objective.worst_cap_tolerance_rationale: strict joint search rows versus full-backend qualified profiles differ at about 1e-9 in states; final selection still compares worst channels without tolerance

search.optimizer: scipy.optimize.minimize(method='SLSQP') on the release objective with scaled hard guards

release.activation_policy: forbidden: activation_allowed false is a prohibition that no explicit user click overrides; the profile may be previewed or selected read-only; activation needs a separately eligible release with dataset, engine and contract identity checks
release.J46: not used; historical J46 already exposed, a free replay could check coverage only
